sourceNote: v2 OFFICIAL: rates transcribed from WotC's 'Collecting Modern Horizons 3' article. Default rare .798 and mythic .130 in the R/M slot plus .067/.011 from the wildcard slot; retro-frame cards at 2.1% (R/M slot) + 4.2% (wildcard) as one pool; borderless Booster Fun at 5.1% + 0.4%. Deliberately unmodelled, all understating EV: the new-to-Modern slot's extra rares/mythics, the wildcard slot's Commander mythics (4.2%), DFC uncommons, and every foil. Mixed-rarity pools (retro, Booster Fun) use uniform-within-pool like every tier. Pool rule: special tiers contain ONLY prints that exist non-foil, priced non-foil; Collector-exclusive foil-only variants stay display-only.
